title: Processes: Soil water (Richards equation)
intro: Water in the matrix moves by the one-dimensional Richards equation, with hydraulic properties from the horizons (retention curve and conductivity). Root uptake is the sink and evaporation the surface boundary; the bottom boundary can be free drainage, a groundwater table or a lysimeter.
